profile_text.body:
InVideo is a video creation company whose site, invideo.io, centers on the invideo Editor. The company describes the editor as a way to create videos without limits, and it presents AI video creation and editing through a feature it calls Agent Two.

The site's pitch is aimed at editors rather than AI specialists. According to the company, a user describes an edit in plain words and invideo's editing agent carries it out on a real multitrack timeline, which the user can take over at any frame. The product tracked for the company is InVideo itself, listed as a video generation and editing tool.

The available record contains no litigation, no MCP server, and no SEC or patent facts for the company.
